user.title: Where do the counters come from?
user.description: The access points count every byte a client sends and receives. The integration can read those counters through your Ruckus gateway (recommended: it keeps the one login to the controller for everyone), with a login of its own, or automatically: gateway first, own login only if the gateway stops answering.

data_description.source: Automatic is the safe choice. 'Gateway only' never logs in to the controller; 'Own login only' is how version 0.2 worked.

gateway.title: Ruckus gateway
gateway.description: Address and key of the gateway's HTTP front door (read-only: it can only hand out the byte counters of Wi-Fi clients).

data_description.gateway_url: Full address including the path, e.g. https://your-gateway-host/ruckus (no trailing slash needed).
data_description.gateway_key: The secret key that belongs to the gateway's front door (RKUS_HTTP_KEY on the gateway).

direct.title: Ruckus controller login
direct.description: Log in to your Ruckus Unleashed / ZoneDirector controller. In Automatic mode this is only the fallback: leave the address empty to skip it. If Home Assistant's own Ruckus integration is set up, the address and user are filled in and you can leave the password empty to reuse its password.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Unleashed master AP (or ZoneDirector).
data_description.password: Leave empty to reuse the password of the built-in Ruckus integration.

clients.title: Clients to measure
clients.description: Pick the Wi-Fi clients (for example your TVs) that should get a throughput sensor. Only connected clients are listed; you can also type a MAC address.

data_description.clients: One 'Wi-Fi throughput' sensor (kbit/s, download + upload) and one 'Wi-Fi data today' sensor are created per client.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (seconds) the counters are read. 60 s matches how often the access points refresh them.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway key or the controller password was refused. Enter the new one (leave a field empty to keep it).

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the counters - check the address (and that the gateway or controller is reachable).
error.invalid_auth: The key or password was refused.
error.host_required: A controller address is needed for this source.

abort.already_configured: This gateway or controller is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key or password works.

init.title: Clients to measure
init.description: Add or remove clients, change how often the counters are read, or change where they come from.

data_description.source: Automatic, gateway only, or own login only.
